claims.claim: Two-part stretto at bars 51-52 (bass two octaves below) and 60-61; both pairs omit the second bar of the subject.
Final section a three-part stretto of inverted entries (77, 78) giving place to the transformed subject (79).
Only canon at the octave used for stretto (with I.11).
Counterexposition uses inverted subject and answer (20-31).
